property_summary: For any caller and recipient and any positive contract balance funded before the call, when the owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) the contract's balance becomes zero (all funds are forwarded to recipient); the mutant that transfers 0 wei violates this because the contract balance remains nonzero for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the transfer call to send zero wei (no funds) to the recipient instead of the contract balance, preventing any funds from being transferred.
